# Rosselli border sheet

Border strips, corners and roundels cut from one engraved sheet of border segments by Francesco Rosselli (Florence, 1490–1500) in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, accession 29.16.3; the strips tile and the corners compose into frames.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `met-356741`, historical, 8 assets.
